items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And with Roz Zimmerman on piano. And Pierre Cirio. And with Paul Dana and myself on saxes.

ctx.x: He quit playing a long time ago. You're going to pull a lot of names I never heard of.

And then I also played with Arthur Selig Sr. at the St. Bernard Country Club after the Haunted Giordino level. We had a nice set up there. We had Arthur Selig Sr. on bass and guitar. And with Roz Zimmerman on piano. And Pierre Cirio. And with Paul Dana and myself on saxes. Charlie DuPont and I too. He was the Bupin on trumpet. And sometimes we had, on the drums we had, the boy's name, he was Lester Gauze. And then the other man that was something for him sometime was Leo Addy. He died too. Yeah. And Arthur Selig…
There was Emmett and there was Buck Rogers.
